conflicts.their_source: RILA Supplement 1 Index des signes, sequence ][.]-31-31-60-73
conflicts.note: The whole dispute is one sign in final position. RILA Supplement 1 itself flags the reading uncertain and prints two variants. The initial ja- is a RILA Supplement 1 restoration, not an observation. The editio princeps, Hallager 2016 pages 290 to 293 figure 81, is not acquired.

rila.period_note: LM IIIA1 in the RILA Supplement 1 concordance row and in the Hallager 2016 chapter title; the concordance metadata is marked UNCERTAIN in our own verification

text_missing_reason: The one source of this record, lineara.xyz, gives no sign-by-sign text for it. The gap is in our sources, not on the object.
